title: [v0.92.2][CF-ADAPTER-CI] Ingest CI repository inputs into a repository packet

spp.plan_summary: Implement CI acquisition by reusing local immutable Git capture and AdmissionInput readback. Keep allowlisted run metadata in a separate packet-bound receipt; explicit source and candidate revisions remain distinct. Add independent ingest/ci CLI dispatch. Required codefriend-ci-acquisition hosted job installs the candidate, consumes a bounded fixture, uploads proof with error-on-missing and validates artifact digest. Wire selection and success/skip into adl-ci. Focused negative/parity tests precede independent exact-head review and native publication; hosted proof remains pending until actual run.
